verdict.rationale: Fly.io's own `fly launch` command, run from the project source directory, creates, configures and (for most apps) deploys a new app, which covers the "no manual build configuration" half of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows deploying by connecting a Git repository; the workflow is CLI-driven from a local directory. missing for 10: documented repo/Git connection for automatic deploys, detail on how build configuration is auto-detected, independent hands-on corroboration of zero-config launches.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy my app by simply connecting my repo without manual build configuration

citations.quote: Run `fly launch` from inside your project source directory to create, configure, and (for most apps) deploy a new application.
